mapper.select: SELECT mp.code AS m_code, mp.id AS m_id, mp.path AS m_path, mp.rating AS m_rating, mp.ranking AS m_ranking, c.*, ifnull(count(cl.cmt_code), 0) AS count_like FROM comments c JOIN ( SELECT m.code, m.id, i.path, m.rating, m.ranking FROM member_account m LEFT JOIN images i ON i.target_code = m.code AND i.type= 'profile' AND i.delete_yn = 0 ) AS mp ON c.mem_code = mp.code LEFT JOIN comment_like cl ON cl.cmt_code = c.code WHERE c.feed_code = #{feedCode} GROUP BY c.code
